text_block_list.text:
After a day out with Найс Нэйчер, the
two of us
are walking home, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that City standing over there?
I wonder
if she's in the middle of a
modeling job.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Wow... Even just the way she's standing
gives off
an otherworldly aura...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I wanna see a little more
sunshine on your
face... Let's take five!
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text: Sure.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature. What are you up to? With
your
trainer too, I see.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: We were just heading back ho—

text_block_list.text:
Talk about breathtaking! You looked so
divine,
my hands clasped together
instinctively in prayer!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
My feelings go beyond admiration—it's
worship! I
feel so blessed!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Haha! Can't say I've heard that one
before.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
There you go, that's the smile I wanted
to see!
Hey, would you two want to join
the photo
shoot?
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text: You want us to join... a photo shoot?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Um... Hold on now. I don't want to
bother them.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Do you want to try? You were just going on
about how much you admire her, after all.

text_block_list.text:
Hold on! That was just talk! I can't
possibly do it!
I'm no model!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: You never know unless you try.

text_block_list.text:
Hold on! That was just talk! I can't
possibly do it!
I'm no model!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: You never know unless you try.

text_block_list.text: Th-that might be true, but the fact that it's impossible for me is the whole reason I admire models!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...I totally understand what you're
saying. They
say the first step is the
hardest.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
In that case, leave it to me. I've got your
back.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Really? Are you actually serious?! I
really don't
know if I can do this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: And so, the photo shoot begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're even stiffer than me. Let's
think
about something funny and relax.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
S-something funny?! I don’t have that
kind of
mental capacity left in me!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
(This sounds like a job for the master of silly
faces—me!)

text_block_list.text: Pffft!
text_block_list.name: Nature and City

text_block_list.text: Hahaha! How are you even doing that?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Amazing! That's the smile I wanted to
see!
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text: We're finally finished...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Good work! And thanks for the help.
The
photographer was really impressed.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, thanks. And you're good at
flattery, as
always.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, I'll send you a copy once
the
magazine releases. You can check
how it turned
out then.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Ohhh... This must be the magazine.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Wait, why's our photo is so big?! I don't
deserve
such a huge space!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Looks like you're trending online too. See?

text_block_list.text:
No, don't show me! I don't want to see
what all
the haters are—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The screen is full of comments praising
Gold City
and Найс Нэйчер's beautiful
smiles... and wishing
for their success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Th-that's enough. I get it, I get it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Siiiigh... Is it hot in here or is it me?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Let's shine on the track too.

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! Let me see you strike a
pose!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: And so, the photo shoot begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So that's why you're Nature's trainer,
huh? You've
got some skill.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Heh, now you've got me motivated.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Amazing! That's the smile I wanted to
see!
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Great job, Trainer. How was your first
modeling
experience?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh, really? I think you did pretty well.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And City, you killed it, just as expected.
It's like
you transformed the whole space
with your
presence.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...You really are something else.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what I was going to say to
you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
What do you think we were talking
about during
the shoot? It was you,
Nature. The entire time.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Um... What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: It just kind of ended up that way...

text_block_list.text:
What?! All those smiles came from
talking about
me?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: That's so... embarrassing!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can see that. But, hey, it sure got
me
motivated. I'm looking forward to
competing with
you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Guess you could say we've got a special
bond
now. Anyway, see you on the
track.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...Ugh! Nooo!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Looks like we've got another race to win!

text_block_list.text: Sigh... You have no idea how I feel...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But all right, I get it. I'll give it the good
old
college try and try to shine in my
own way.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер seems more enthusiastic
than usual
at training after that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
